title: Contraction theory: Hausdorff--Riemann Measures as Set-Based Lyapunov Functions
summary: We offer a measure-theoretic extension of the concept and theory of $k$-contraction, including their generalization on fractional dimensions $d$. The respective contraction property is defined through the exponential decay of the $d$-dimensional volume of compact sets transported by a nonlinear flow. For autonomous systems on positively invariant compact sets, we derive comprehensive, i.e., necessary and sufficient, conditions for $d$-contractivity in two complementary forms.
